content.value: The grade on a quiz were $0 , 1 , 2 , . . . , 1 0$ points, depending the number answered correctly (10) [CO4] out of 50 questions. The mean grade was 6.25 and the standard deviation was. 1.25. Express with appropriate assumptions to determine the following probabilities.
i) the percentage of student scoring 6.0 point.
ii) the maximum grade of the lowest 20% of the class.
iii) the minimum grade of the highest 15% of the class.
